request: Improve useful notifications for Free and Pro after the owner reported no daily Pro message and an unchanged daily offer.
findings: The same IKEA offer was selected on October 25, 26 and 27. Selection ranking did not account for the seven-day push repeat guard.
A non-production device or unavailable transport could create a real campaign record before being excluded from delivery.
The old featured workflow started after the morning push window. The new schedule has 34 instead of 44 daily slots, starting before morning.
The exact reason on the owner's handset is unconfirmed: individual current delivery history was not accessible.
changes: Bounded in-snapshot featured selection history retains seven complete prior Vienna calendar days and same-day manual picks; current manual choices remain authoritative.
Automatic selection avoids recent exact deal IDs, prioritizes push-eligible offers and restricts automatic features to supported food and non-alcoholic drinks.
Test devices and unavailable transports are excluded before creating campaigns; existing claims and campaign records are never reset.
The weekly recap may include still-valid approved offers published within 30 days. New-deal messages remain limited to the last seven days.
Private diagnostics distinguish repeat suppression, missing current selection, test environments and unavailable transports; audience data is aggregate-only.
unchanged: Free/Pro consent, opt-outs, OS permission and all marketing flags
Pro morning window and existing twice-weekly policy-v3 digest schedule
Human publication approval, source-grounded dates, freshness and moderation exclusions
Provider exactly-once claims, unknown-outcome no-retry policy and production-only automatic delivery
Email sending, existing invitation notifications and optional trial reminders
All native source files, app versions, Store artifacts, scraping and AI budgets; paid card editor remains disabled
